FROM dim_member
WHERE join_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-09-29' AND DATE '2026-10-06'
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

calls.statement:
WITH first_ver AS (
  SELECT member_id, join_date, home_store_id, valid_from, member_key,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY member_id ORDER BY valid_from, member_key) AS rn,
         COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY member_id) AS nver,
         COUNT(DISTINCT join_date) OVER (PARTITION BY member_id) AS njd
  FROM dim_member)
SELECT home_store_id, COUNT(*) AS n, SUM(CASE WHEN nver>1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS multi, SUM(CASE WHEN njd>1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS multi_jd, SUM(CASE WHEN valid_from<>join_date THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS vf_diff
FROM first_ver WHERE rn=1 AND join_date = DATE '2026-10-03'
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT COUNT(*) AS rows_, COUNT(DISTINCT member_id) AS ids, COUNT(DISTINCT member_key) AS keys, SUM(CASE WHEN join_date > DATE '2026-10-04' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS future_join,
 SUM(CASE WHEN member_id IS NULL OR join_date IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS nulls
FROM dim_member
